chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him) to Qutham ibn al-Abbas, while he was his governor over Mecca.

key_terms.عَامِلُهُ: His governor/agent, referring to the administrative appointee
key_terms.قُثَمَ بْنِ الْعَبَّاسِ: Qutham ibn al-Abbas, the recipient of the letter
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Mecca, the city under his governance

ai.seo_question: Who was Qutham ibn al-Abbas and what was his role in Mecca according to Imam Ali's letter?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a key administrative letter from Imam Ali (AS) to Qutham ibn al-Abbas, his trusted governor of Mecca, highlighting the practical application of his governance during the early Caliphate. It sets the stage for detailed instructions on justice, tax collection, and moral conduct, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the Imam's role as both a spiritual and political leader. The mention of Qutham, a cousin of the Prophet, underscores the familial and authoritative nature of this appointment.
